options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: big_query_source
options.description: Configures how data is supposed to be extracted from a BigQuery source to be loaded onto the FeatureOnlineStore.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: feature_online_store
options.description: The name of the FeatureOnlineStore to use for the featureview. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: feature_registry_source
options.description: Configures the features from a Feature Registry source that need to be loaded onto the FeatureOnlineStore.

options.name: labels
options.description: A set of key/value label pairs to assign to this FeatureView. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the FeatureView. This value may be up to 60 characters, and valid characters are [a-z0-9_]. The first character cannot be a number. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: region
options.description: The region for the resource. It should be the same as the featureonlinestore region. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.

options.name: sync_config
options.description: Configures when data is to be synced/updated for this FeatureView. At the end of the sync the latest featureValues for each entityId of this FeatureView are made ready for online serving.

options.name: vector_search_config
options.description: Configuration for vector search. It contains the required configurations to create an index from source data, so that approximate nearest neighbor (a.k.a ANN) algorithms search can be performed during online serving. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.
